trumpLegend.title: Top-trump order
trumpLegend.caption: Trump strength is fixed (current trump: {{suit}}). The three top trumps (trump 5, J, and ♥A) carry no follow obligation and may be held back (Reneging). Other trumps use a simplified 10-high order (no red/black reversal).

hint.lead_high: Lead a high card to take the trick
hint.take_trick: Win this trick (3 tricks takes the pot)
hint.discard_low: Can't win — discard a low card

tutorial.trickDisplay: This is the current trick. You must follow the lead suit, but the three top trumps — the trump 5, trump J, and ♥A (always a trump) — may be held back (Reneging). Trump beats non-trump, ranked 5 > J > ♥A > A > K > Q > other trumps.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand (5 cards). Click any card to select it. Trump is set by the turned-up card on the table.
tutorial.playButton: Once a card is selected, play it with this button. The player who plays the strongest card wins the trick.
tutorial.info: Five players compete for a pot each round. The first player to win 3 of the 5 tricks takes the pot immediately. If nobody reaches 3 tricks the round is a Spoil (流局) and the pot carries to the next round. The first player to reach the target score (30 by default) wins the match.
tutorial.resetButton: Use the reset button to start a new game.
